Restoration Indicator Score per 2018 land-cover class under three weight profiles, over documented-burned and over model-detected 30 m pixels (mean and median), with indicator means and Notebook 13 normalisation context. Cross-class differences largely reflect the NBR baseline normalization, not ecological recovery.

**Sources (column → raster / array).**

- `population` — documented-burned: fig_gt_fires.shp (2017-2025) on the 30 m grid; model-detected: burned_prob_30m.tif > 0.502
- `land_cover` — data/raw/landcover_2018_30m.tif (landcover_smoothed_yearly 2018, b1, 30 m mode)
- `RIS_<profile>_mean / _median` — weighted sum of severity_30m.tif, persistence_30m.tif, recovery_gap_30m.tif, model_recurrence_30m.tif
- `<indicator>_mean` — outputs/inference_full_roi/<indicator>_30m.tif
- `nb13_*` — diagnostics/nb13_landcover_timing/tables/nb13_t04a_recovery_gap_distribution_by_class.csv (10 m burned sample; reused, not recomputed)
